drivingQuestion: From where do we know kilei hakerem are forbidden for benefit?

segments.he: בְּכִלְאֵי הַכֶּרֶם מְנָלַן? אָמַר חִזְקִיָּה: אָמַר קְרָא: ״פֶּן תִּקְדַּשׁ״ – פֶּן תּוּקַד אֵשׁ.
segments.en: The mishna stated that one may not betroth a woman «with diverse kinds in a vineyard. From where do we» derive that one is prohibited from deriving benefit from diverse kinds in a vineyard? «Ḥizkiyya said: The verse states:» “You shall not sow your vineyard with diverse kinds; lest the growth of the seed that you have sown be forbidden [pen tikdash], together with the yield of the vineyard” (Deuteronomy 22:9). Ḥizkiyya expounds «“lest» the growth of the seed that you have sown «be forbidden [pen tikdash]”» as: «Lest it be burned [pen tukad esh],» indicating that the seed of diverse kinds must be destroyed by fire, so that no benefit is derived from it.
